c46bc10751.why: Preserving xmm1 requires separate load and comparison instructions, and the pointer update, live scalar mask, and final flags require the remaining three instructions.

f16d4e14db.why: The load and destructive SSE2 comparison are needed to preserve xmm1, while the mask extraction, pointer update, and flag-setting test each produce required outputs.

371fbb9b76.rewrite:
shld ecx,edi,0x1e
and ecx,0xf
and rdi,0xffffffffffffffc0
add rdx,rcx
371fbb9b76.why: SHLD places the original rdi bits 2..5 into ecx bits 0..3, and AND discards every other bit, replacing the copy/mask/shift with two instructions. The aligned rdi and adjusted rdx are preserved, and no flags must match.

77fc26a3a6.why: The comparison vectors and their accumulated maxima are all live, and SSE2 still needs mask extraction plus a scalar test to produce the required ZF.

320e597a8c.why: Both comparison vectors and the scalar mask are live, so neither comparison nor the load, extraction, or final flag-setting test can be removed.

256258c674.why: The counter update, comparison vector, scalar mask, and ZF are required, leaving no redundant instruction in this SSE2 sequence.

4d4035ba45.why: The full comparison vector and incremented scalar mask are live, requiring the load, comparison, mask extraction, and increment.

f9971cd4f5.why: Preserving ymm2, rax, and ZF requires both memory inputs, the vector comparison, the scalar mask extraction, and its increment.

573878b866.why: Although rcx is scratch, the required ymm3 comparison result and incremented rax mask still need all four instructions.

1513372f2b.why: The live ymm4 comparison result and incremented rcx mask require the load, comparison, extraction, and increment.

8c733e3a82.why: The indexed comparison vector and incremented rax mask are live, and INC supplies the required ZF while preserving the incoming CF.

8a8b340331.why: All four instructions contribute to the required comparison vector, incremented scalar mask, and final flags.

0b87a6c017.why: The comparison vector, incremented rax mask, and separately truncated rdx mask are all live, so the load, comparison, extraction, increment, and BZHI are needed.

e246221953.why: The two eight-byte loads with zeroed upper lanes, vector comparison, mask extraction, and subtraction are needed to preserve ymm1, ymm2, rax, and ZF.

6f3c1355fc.why: Both memory inputs, the live comparison vector, and the subtracted scalar mask require the existing load, comparison, extraction, and subtraction.

78da7e9e82.why: The live ecx and k2 masks, masked load result, k1 comparison result, rax mask, and final TEST flags leave no removable instruction.

c40ccbbf25.why: The loaded vector, k1 mask, and rax mask must all be preserved, and the comparison and KMOV do not set the required ZF.

961a28489b.why: The vector load, comparison into k1, transfer into rax, and test each supply a required register value or ZF.

dd8740d30b.why: Even with rcx available as scratch, the live zmm19, k1, and rax outputs plus ZF require the existing four instructions.

8d3ea256e2.why: The loaded zmm20 value, comparison mask k1, scalar mask rcx, and ZF each require their existing instruction.
